title: Knowledge After Collapse: Context and Wording Shape Factual Accessibility in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model accepts a false correction in a factual discussion, its next answer can depend on how the conversation continues. We introduce Knowledge Answer Divergence (KAD), an event-conditioned evaluation protocol that distinguishes initial false-answer adoption from subsequent persistence, recovery, and abstention. KAD freezes the conversation at the first explicit adoption of a designated false target and branches independent probes from that exact history. This enables matched comparisons of post-adoption behavior and history-management interventions that a single susceptibility score cannot capture. We evaluate eight local checkpoint conditions and six hosted endpoints, alongside an audited 300-question rerun. In corrected Llama 3.2 Instruct 3B controls, a neutral-history branch yields 42/46 correct responses, compared with 16/46 under full history. A matched cue-placement control changes false adoption by 27.3 percentage

translated_title: 知识崩溃之后：上下文与措辞塑造语言模型中事实的可及性
translated_abstract: 当语言模型在事实性讨论中接受了一个错误的更正时，它的下一个答案可能取决于对话如何继续。我们引入了知识答案分歧，这是一种事件条件化的评估协议，能够区分模型最初对错误答案的采纳与随后的持续、恢复和弃权行为。KAD 在模型第一次明确采纳指定错误目标时冻结对话，并从该确切历史分支出独立的探针，这使得对采纳后行为和历史管理干预进行匹配比较成为可能，而单一的易感性评分无法捕捉这些差异。我们评估了八个本地检查点条件和六个托管端点，并进行了一次经过审计的300题重跑。在经过更正的 Llama 3.2 Instruct 3B 对照组中，中性历史分支产生了 42/46 的正确回答，而完整历史下仅为 16/46；一个匹配的线索位置对照使错误采纳率改变了 27.3 个百分点。
tldr: 提出知识答案分歧（KAD）评估协议，通过在模型首次采纳错误答案时冻结对话并分支独立探针，揭示了对话历史与措辞方式显著影响语言模型在错误采纳后恢复正确事实的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces Knowledge Answer Divergence (KAD), an event-conditioned evaluation protocol that freezes conversations at the first false-answer adoption and branches independent probes, revealing that conversation history and wording significantly shape language models' ability to recover factual accuracy after accepting a false correction.
